fusions.name: Whipped In
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Full Cry
fusions.desc: A baying call that deals 25 resonating damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Leash
fusions.desc: Slips a hound that fights beside you for 18 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood Scent
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
